# QCrypt archive

> Static copies of the websites of past International Conference on Quantum Cryptography (QCrypt) conferences, 2011–2026, preserved by the International Association for Quantum Information (IAQI). Pages are archived as they were published; programs, accepted papers, abstracts and slides are mostly in HTML and PDF.

The current conference is at https://qcrypt.net/. For structured, machine-readable data (talks, posters, authors with ORCID, committees, videos) use QuantumDB, which covers the same conferences: https://quantumdb.iaqi.org/llms.txt (data under CC0 1.0).

## Structured data (recommended for agents)

- [All conferences, with links to every per-year export](https://quantumdb.iaqi.org/api/v1/export/all.json)
- One conference as JSON: `https://quantumdb.iaqi.org/api/v1/export/conferences/qcrypt-<year>`; CSV: append `/talks.csv`, `/posters.csv` or `/committees.csv`
- [QuantumDB guide for LLMs](https://quantumdb.iaqi.org/llms.txt)

## Archived editions

### QCrypt 2026

2026-08-24 to 2026-08-28; Ottawa, Canada

- [Archived website](https://qcrypt.iaqi.org/2026/)
- [Schedule](https://qcrypt.iaqi.org/2026/schedule.html)
- [Accepted papers](https://qcrypt.iaqi.org/2026/technical/accepted-papers/)
- [Speakers](https://qcrypt.iaqi.org/2026/speakers.html)
- Data: [JSON](https://quantumdb.iaqi.org/api/v1/export/conferences/qcrypt-2026), [talks CSV](https://quantumdb.iaqi.org/api/v1/export/conferences/qcrypt-2026/talks.csv), [posters CSV](https://quantumdb.iaqi.org/api/v1/export/conferences/qcrypt-2026/posters.csv), [committees CSV](https://quantumdb.iaqi.org/api/v1/export/conferences/qcrypt-2026/committees.csv), [QuantumDB page](https://quantumdb.iaqi.org/conferences/qcrypt-2026)

## Rights

Facts about the conferences (titles, authors, dates) are free to use; QuantumDB dedicates its data to the public domain (CC0 1.0). Abstracts, slides, photos and recordings remain the property of their authors.
